projects.title: Learn Money: A web application to teach personal finance
projects.description: Personal finance is the area of education that is often not part of regular education coursework while it is crucial for making sound financial decisions. Knowledge of money instruments and their underlying working can help in making decisions in a more informed manner. The goal of the project was to develop a solution that helps college students get the basic information about various money instruments they might use in their current life and make sound decisions accordingly. The developed solution provides an interactive way to impart the knowledge through a web application as it simulates the real-life tasks and results of actions.

projects.title: Chest X-Ray disease diagnosis
projects.description:
Given the recent large availability of large, labeled datasets of disease diagnosis from chest radiographs, there have been various attempts at creating automated diagnosis systems. We have used one such large dataset(CheXpert - Stanford ML group ref:https://stanfordmlgroup.github.io/competitions/chexpert/ ) in this project to carry out automatic detection of diseases from chest x-rays. We have used Big Data tech- pyspark and transfer learning and deep convolution neural networks to achieve this.

Technologies Used: Apache Pyspark , Python

We also submitted project results to Chexpert competition(https://stanfordmlgroup.github.io/competitions/chexpert/) and got listed on Leaderboard.

projects.title: Human computer interaction through Gestures
projects.description:
The project aims at controlling VLC media player by using dynamic hand gestures as input.

Various functions of VlC linked with gestures are:play/pause,increase volume,decrease volume,stop,crop

summary.overview:
Uptiq is a technology company that provides an AI-driven platform designed to support financial services firms with real-time analytics, risk assessment, and decision-making workflows. The company’s platform uses machine learning to process and interpret large volumes of financial data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights that help teams evaluate credit risk, detect anomalies, and inform portfolio strategies. Its tools support integration with existing data systems and workflows, enabling users to automate data ingestion, modeling, and reporting across lending, investment, and compliance functions.

Uptiq also offers customizable dashboards and APIs that help financial analysts, risk officers, and product teams operationalize insights and align them with business objectives. The company works with banks, fintechs, and financial institutions to tailor AI models and analytic frameworks to specific use cases such as credit scoring, customer lifetime value prediction, and loss forecasting. Its platform emphasizes scalable data processing and transparent model outputs to support informed decision-making in financial operations.
summary.seo: UPTIQ enables financial advisors to connect their clients to a network of lenders who can fund any liquidity objective, including buying a new home or vacation property, starting a new business, funding working capital for an existing business, financing college tuition and more.

Founded by industry veterans, Uptiq is the 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐭𝐡, 𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐮𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐬𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬— orchestrating your systems, processes, and teams without replacing what already works.

This means no replacements, no disruption. Just intelligence layered over your existing systems, giving your people the power to do more with what they already have.

Uptiq is everything your financial institution needs to automate decisions, coordinate workflows, and act on intelligence - without replacing a single system you already trust.

𝐐𝐎𝐑𝐄: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐋𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫
Coordinates financial work across systems the way an experienced financial professional would - with governance built in.

𝐀𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐃𝐢𝐠𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐞𝐫𝐬
Autonomous financial operators that execute complex workflows across systems - with precision, auditability, and human oversight.

𝐒𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬: 𝐏𝐚𝐜𝐤𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐝 𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬
Pre-configured execution models that deliver measurable outcomes across lending, servicing, risk, and growth.

Uptiq is Built Around How Financial Work Actually Gets Done. Our Pre-built operating suites that unlock speed, scale, and governance - without replacing core systems.

Trusted by over 150 financial institutions, including Focus Financial Partners, Orion, Broadridge, and TransPecos Banks, Uptiq is the proven AI partner for highly regulated industries. With over $1 billion in transactions processed and more than $55M in equity funding, Uptiq isn’t just shaping the future of AI in financial services — it’s leading it.
summary.overview:
Uptiq is a technology company that provides an AI-driven platform designed to support financial services firms with real-time analytics, risk assessment, and decision-making workflows. The company’s platform uses machine learning to process and interpret large volumes of financial data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights that help teams evaluate credit risk, detect anomalies, and inform portfolio strategies. Its tools support integration with existing data systems and workflows, enabling users to automate data ingestion, modeling, and reporting across lending, investment, and compliance functions.

Uptiq also offers customizable dashboards and APIs that help financial analysts, risk officers, and product teams operationalize insights and align them with business objectives. The company works with banks, fintechs, and financial institutions to tailor AI models and analytic frameworks to specific use cases such as credit scoring, customer lifetime value prediction, and loss forecasting. Its platform emphasizes scalable data processing and transparent model outputs to support informed decision-making in financial operations.
summary.seo: UPTIQ enables financial advisors to connect their clients to a network of lenders who can fund any liquidity objective, including buying a new home or vacation property, starting a new business, funding working capital for an existing business, financing college tuition and more.

I am a computer engineer with a bachelor's degree, currently working at UPTIQ to develop the UPTIQ AI Workbench - a powerful platform empowering fintechs to create AI agents tailored for custom and complex use cases.

I have a strong foundation in web technologies, with a primary focus on the MERN stack. My expertise includes TypeScript, C++, and Python, and I am always eager to explore and build innovative solutions that push boundaries.

In my free time, I enjoy reading books, solving programming challenges, and diving into the fascinating world of algorithms to understand how they work and apply them creatively.
